description: Image Description: The image shows a disc golf basket, commonly used in disc golf courses. The basket is made of red metal with a circular top frame from which multiple silver chains hang down. These chains are designed to catch and guide flying discs into the basket below. The lower part of the basket features a red wire-mesh basket that collects the discs. Inside the basket, there are two discs visible: one is orange with a white logo or design on it, and the other appears to be yellow
